title: Vector Inspector: per-endpoint signalization, cost split, and adaptive alerts for embeddings + rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a unified "Vector Inspector" observability surface for embeddings + reranking that provides per-endpoint dashboards, distributed tracing spans for vector scoring, fine-grained cost-splitting back to routes, and adaptive alerting. The goal is to let PMs/SEs quickly diagnose quality regressions, latency hotspots, and cost spikes for individual endpoints and cohorts without pulling logs manually.
acceptance_criteria: Per-endpoint dashboard template created in Console with latency P50/P95/P99, tokens-per-request, average candidate count, and relevance drift chart
Tracing: start/end spans for embed lookup, vector scoring, and final rerank with correlation IDs propagated to client traces
Cost breakdown: token and model-inference cost attributed to request path, exported to billing view and visible per-endpoint in console
Alerting: adaptive baseline alerts for endpoint latency and relevance score drop with runbook links
Synthetic probes: ability to attach a small eval set per-route and ship daily cohort health metrics
implementation_notes: Emit new telemetry events: vector.request (metadata), vector.score (candidate_id, score, latency_ns), vector.cache_hit boolean
Add explicit span names: embed.encode, embed.lookup, vector.scatter, vector.score, rerank.aggregate
Correlation: use X-Redwood-Trace and route_id tag for cross-service joins
Cost attribution: annotate spans with model_variant and token_count; post-process traces to map to per-route cost using current pricing table
Dashboards: Grafana panels templated by route_id; Console will embed these via panel URL with read-only tokens
Adaptive alerts: baseline computed from rolling 28-day median and sigma; alert triggers when metric exceeds median + 3*sigma or relevance drops by >7% absolute on synthetic probe
work_done_and_progress: 2025-02-16: Spike completed to validate trace span overhead on a busy rerank route (~<3% p95 increase) — prototype attached (github.com/redwood/telemetry-spikes/PR-67)
2025-02-21: Telemetry schema v2 proposed for vector.* events, reviewed by Observability and Runtime teams — feedback incorporated
2025-02-25: Console dashboard template mock uploaded to Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Vector+Inspector+Mock)
2025-03-01: First pass tracing instrumentation landed in runtime branch (github.com/redwood/runtime/compare/feat/vector-traces), tests added for span tagging
2025-03-03: Cost post-processor prototype implemented as a daily job; mapping table validated against last 30 days of billing logs
risks_and_mitigations: Increased telemetry volume could raise observability costs — mitigation: sample candidate-level vector.score events at 5% by default and allow route override
Instrumentation latency: spans add extra headers/serialization — mitigation: span payloads kept minimal and sampling applied to heavy routes
Attribution mismatch for routes using multi-model fallbacks — mitigation: include fallback chain in trace and flag ambiguous attribution in billing UI
False positives from adaptive alerts during rollout windows — mitigation: auto-suppress alerts for routes in 'rollout' state and add cooldowns
review_feedback: 2025-02-20 from Nisha Raman (Observability): prefer sample-by-route policy rather than uniform sampling; updated plan accordingly
2025-02-24 from Marco Silva (Runtime): suggested adding model_variant tag early in the pipeline to prevent post-hoc joins; implemented
2025-03-02 from PM Emma Liu: asked for a compact 'health score' metric for each route to surface in the console top nav — MVP added to ACs
next_steps: Finish route-level dashboard wiring in Console and add embedded Grafana panels (owner: Liam)
Deploy tracing instrumentation to staging for three high-traffic routes for a 72h soak (owner: SRE)
Finalize adaptive alert thresholds and add synthetic probe harness to nightly jobs (owner: Observability)

notes: This ticket focuses on observability for embeddings+rerank endpoints only; future work will extend to retrieval and cross-route cohort comparisons.
Keep storage of candidate-level scores short-lived (7 days) and redact candidate identifiers for privacy by default
